bestBets.overview: MISSION TAICHI looks to have a lot going for him in this highweight maiden. All the starts so far have produced solid performances. He's proven himself on heavy ground and at this trip. Blinkers might be the key. Will Gordon is a big advantage in these races . I'MNODRUMMERBOY is very fit and proven on very heavy ground. HEMI TWO BARRELL was heavily supported to win first go. Wide and partial cover I say. Clearly with his upside and home track advantage he's a chance. He does seem very short when you consider HELTER PELTZER beat him home at Coleraine.

raceTips.comment:
Mission Taichi gets blinkers on after being beaten as an odds-on favourite last start at Wangaratta. He has the advantage of Will Gordon riding in a highweight. 
Hemi Two Barrell started $3 on debut in an effort easily forgiven as he was caught wide without cover. He might relish the rise in distance at his second start with a jumpout between runs.

bestBets.overview: REDDIVO looks a legitimate short priced fav in this highweight marathon after his 12L win last time. That was on very heavy ground.  Concede he rises 14.5kg but he's already ticked the highweight box having won a race like this November 2024. MATTHEW MARK finished on REDDIVO's heels at Geelong July 10 so that gives him some hope. REDDIVO however was stronger through the line. SMOKIN' ROHIE gets to a trip like this for the first time. He's never far away.  Don't know KICKING KING on anything softer than a 5 but he certainly has the class to win a race like this.

raceTips.comment:
Reddivo was dominant winning a similar race in similar conditions last start. Even allowing for the highweight conditions of the race he does rise in weight relatively however it's arguably a weaker race and most of his main rivals are either a query at the distance, have a query on their recent form or are a query as to whether they're at peak fitness. 
Tosen Glory hit the line strongly last start however his two starts over 3000m don't exactly fill you with confidence. 
Kicking King might be the best horse in the race however tackling 3000m second up on heavy ground is a big ask.

bestBets.overview: A very modest race and nothing will surprise. ALLTOGETHERNOW had excuses 1st up in a highweight maiden. In his first campaign he had two starts and went from a 1200m debut to a 2000m maiden on a H9. He ran ok. With Will Gordon I've seen worse $51 chances. FIOROWNGOOD was terrible in one of these on a H10 two back. Either side, well away from H10 and at 1400m he's run well. Of course he's a chance but his odds are unappealing given that thrashing here two back. HILL CRY ran through the line just as well as FIOROWNGOOD last time. At the odds, rather be with her.  Unsure if STAFF WRITER wants this distance increase or not but she's showing enough to say she can win a race or two. WINTER ARC made a satisfactory debut on testing ground.

raceTips.comment:
There was little between Hill Cry and Fiorowngood at Casterton last start where the former was the stronger the last 50m and through the line, albeit with arguably the preferred run closer to the rail given the pattern on the day. 
Fiorowngood struggled on a bottomless heavy track at Warrnambool two starts ago and that has to be the main query here given the early price being shopped. 
Winter Arc was well beaten on debut in a weak race but the starting price there suggests he might be better for that experience.

THAIMOR is fast and she always jumps out well. One start in Summer and spelled could mean they think she is a wet tracker. The jump outs have been impressive. Nothing really surprises.

Moonraker raced wide without cover behind a subsequent city winner last start and crucially handled the track conditions.
Thaimor jumped out impressively and has won her only start on heavy ground.

bestBets.overview: Impossible race. Hoping that back to 1400m is the key to BIG ROOSTER. After the 1500m Ballarat win he hasn't gone on with it. His stablemate HEED THE OMENS returns and this is his stable debut. A BM62 looks very suitable. His latest jump out was with PARKRUN who has had three to prepare. He is going well. KINGSFORD is another one returning worth respecting. IBERIAN LYNX maps well.

raceTips.comment:
I found this a tough race because two of the horses that create the most interest are first up, which is likely not ideal given the conditions. 
Big Rooster has race fitness on side and I suspect he might have simply not run out a strong 1700m last start. Back in distance he looks well placed to produce the sort of form he showed earlier in the preparation which would be good enough to make him a leading chance in this race (if you can make ground and run on).
Kingsford has jumped out nicely like he's fit and forward. While he's never seen heavy ground on race day, his soft track form is strong and his latest heavy track jumpout gives hope he might be a wet-tracker. 
Heed The Omens makes his debut for the new stable. His jumpout was solid and his wet track form is strong. If he's forward enough to produce anything like his best he's well placed.

raceTips.comment:
Sir Rockford hit the line strongly at Sandwn last start and is suited dropping in class on wet ground. He's been underwhelming in his last two starts on heavy tracks this preparation, however one was first up when he likely needed the run and the other was fresh off a let up and probably unsuited over 1600m. 
Shamex is fit, in form, handles heavy ground and races on speed.
Bellonado won at the track on a heavy 10 last start which is potentially half the battle.
